'''Ancient Askajian''' was an early incarnation of the [[Askajian language|language]] spoken by the members of the [[Askajian/Legends|Askajian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Song of the Dongtha Slayer]] was written in ancient Askajian, and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] called [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] could recite all the known verses of that poem.
